name: The Night We Met
source: Experience an unforgettable Halloween party through the eyes of Alex, Anna, and Sierra. Immerse yourself in a story divided into four distinct Acts, where you’ll get to know the characters, flirt with them, and play the greatest Truth or Dare game ever.
